title:
Analysis code for Pagiatakis et al., The cardiac enhancer RNA Chheaf preserves heart function during stress
 adaptation via Rtn4-dependent autophagy
description: Analysis code for Pagiatakis et al., The cardiac enhancer RNA Chheaf preserves heart function during stress adaptation via Rtn4-dependent autophagy. One script per figure panel that rests on a comput ational analysis: differential expression and CPM matrices, lincRNA selection, synteny and coverage tracks, single-nucl eus and spatial transcriptomics of GSE176092, GSEA, and the tables of Data S1 and Data S2. Each script writes to results/ and prints the numbers it produced, and expected/ holds the same tables as obtained for th e paper, so a run can be diffed against the published values. Input paths are placeholders set in 00_config.R and 00_config.sh or from the environment; two third-party inputs are fetched by the scripts in d ata/ rather than redistributed.
